statement: The United States conducts a military strike on Iran's Pickaxe Mountain facility, the underground site near Natanz also called Kuh-e Kolang Gaz La, between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-08.
resolution: TRUE if confirmed by a US DoD or CENTCOM statement, an Iranian government acknowledgement, or two wire services among Reuters, AP, and AFP. Threats or satellite-activity reporting alone do not satisfy this.
failure_condition: No strike on the Pickaxe Mountain site occurs, or none is confirmed by the stated standard, within the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
